name: login
title: Login
description: An email and password sign-in that settles in row by row, with inline errors and provider buttons.

perf.budget: The entrance is a one-off layout animation per block on the UI thread; after that the screen is static apart from the button's press spring.

measurements.notes: Most janky frames are the software keyboard opening and closing on the emulator; scrolling the form stays at the baseline.

a11y.reducedMotion: Blocks appear in place, the title appears without rising and the password eye switches without animating (Reveal Field).
a11y.screenReader: Fields are named Email and Password; their errors are read as they appear. A failed sign-in is an alert. The button reports when it is busy.
a11y.touchTarget: Fields are 52 pt tall; the button is 56 pt; links are at least 44 pt.
